name: Atari / Sierra Logo Treatment
summary: Sliced 80s publisher logos: a wordmark or divider cut into horizontal bands that step thick-to-thin, filled with a red/orange/yellow/green/blue rainbow over a near-black or silver field.
whenToUse: When the user asks for Atari/Sierra-era logo treatment, rainbow stripes, a sliced or thickness-gradient wordmark, a game title screen, or an 80s publisher-brand surface.
rules: The slice stack is the system: five horizontal bands of decreasing thickness — 8px red #e8402a, 6px orange #f08a24, 4px yellow #f5c518, 3px green #52b545, 2px blue #2f7fe0 (23px total). Never reorder, resample, or re-weight the bands; scale the whole 23px stack by integer factors only.

A wordmark is built by slicing letterforms, not by outlining them: split the display text into the same five bands, give each band its own row height and a 1px horizontal plate shift, and let the changing band thickness carry the logo effect. Band spacing stays constant — the thickness is the only variable.
Slice each letterform with a per-band clip-path inset (0 0 calc(100% - var(--band-top)) 0) so each band is its own <span> with its own height and a 1px plate offset.

Rainbow is structural, never decorative: it appears only as the banded slice stack (wordmark, divider, panel rule, statusbar chip) or as a legitimate 5-stop stripe. No rainbow gradients, no blurred rainbow glows, no rainbow background washes behind body copy.

Field is either near-black #0a0a0d or silver #c9cbd1 — pick one per surface. The dark field carries the saturated rainbow; the silver field uses the desaturated silverField variant so the stripes stay legible against #c9cbd1.

Type is uppercase geometric display: Audiowide (or Orbitron) for wordmarks, titles, buttons, and section heads at 0.02em–0.08em tracking; Space Mono for body, labels, table data, and numeric readouts at 0.12em tracking when uppercase.
Geometry is orthogonal: radius 0, no diagonal cuts, no circles, no bevels. Every edge is a horizontal line, and every block of color is a rectangle whose only dimension that varies is its height.

Elevation is a hard offset only — 6px 6px 0 #000000 for detached plates, none for slices. The slice stack itself provides the visual depth of the system, so slices never cast shadows and never sit on a blurred one.

Motion is stepped in five beats: bands reveal top-to-bottom in rainbow order at steps(5, end) with 0/120/360/900ms durations. No eased fades, no rotations, no scaling wordmarks on hover — a band wipe or an instant state change only.

componentRecipes.card: background:#16171c;color:#ececee;border:0;border-radius:0;padding:24px 32px;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #000000; a 23px slice stack (8/6/4/3/2 rainbow) pins to the top edge, the header sits below it in Audiowide 14px uppercase #f5c518, body = Space Mono 16px/1.5 #ececee, and a footer action row uses the yellow button; the body fill is a separate element below the band so the stack never repeats behind text.
componentRecipes.select: A publisher dropdown: trigger = Space Mono 16px field with a 3px #2a2b33 bottom rule that swaps to the 12px micro-slice on focus, value in #ececee with a yellow '▾'; the open list is a 1px #2a2b33 frame on #16171c where the selected row carries the full 23px band on its left edge and hover lightens the label to #ffffff; no radius.
componentRecipes.checkbox: A 20px square plate: background:#0a0a0d;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid #2a2b33;border-radius:0; checked = a 10px #f5c518 square with a 1px #0a0a0d plate offset; radio = 8px #e8402a dot; label in Space Mono 16px #ececee with 'ON'/'OFF'; focus-visible = 3px #2f7fe0 outline at 3px offset.
componentRecipes.badge: A flat slice-chip: display:inline-flex;gap:8px;padding:4px 10px;background:#0a0a0d;border:0;border-radius:0;font:12px/1 'Space Mono';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.12em; a 4px left band in the role color (#52b545/#f08a24/#ff4b3e/#f5c518) plus the word; never a rounded pill, never icon-only.
componentRecipes.avatar: A 32px square plate: background:#0a0a0d;border:0;border-radius:0;color:#ececee;font:14px/1 'Audiowide'; initials or a two-letter mark; image avatars get a 23px slice stack as a bottom border and image-rendering:auto; integer scaling only.
componentRecipes.nav: A horizontal publisher rail: items = Audiowide 13px uppercase #ececee, padding 12px 16px 15px; the active item keeps plate #16171c, turns #f5c518, and gains the 12px hairline slice stack as an under-rule plus box-shadow 4px 4px 0 #000000; hover lightens to #ffffff; dropdowns are 1px #2a2b33 frames with the selected row carrying the 23px left band.
componentRecipes.table: A slice-stack data grid: header = Audiowide 12px uppercase #ececee with the 23px band pinned under it as a rule; body rows = Space Mono 16px #ececee separated by 1px #2a2b33 rules; hover = #ffffff, selected row = #f5c518 text with a 4px left band in the rainbow; values tabular, radius 0.
componentRecipes.dialog: A publisher modal: panel recipe with the 23px slice stack on the top edge; scrim = color-mix(in srgb, var(--overlay) 60%, transparent); title = Audiowide uppercase #ececee, body = Space Mono, actions = yellow primary + #16171c secondary with the slice-stack left column; entrance is a 360ms steps(5) band wipe.
componentRecipes.toast: A bottom-right status plate: background:#0a0a0d;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid;padding:12px 16px;font:Space Mono 14px uppercase; a 4px left band in the role color (#52b545/#f08a24/#ff4b3e) plus the word (SAVED, WARNING, ERROR); auto-dismisses with a 360ms steps(5) wipe, reduced motion keeps it static.
componentRecipes.code: A monospace block: background:#0a0a0d;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid #2a2b33;border-radius:0;padding:16px;font:14px/1.5 'Space Mono';color:#ececee; preserve whitespace; comments #86878f, strings #f5c518, errors #ff4b3e; the block keeps the 12px micro-slice focus rule.
componentRecipes.empty: A centred panel with a small 23px slice-stack glyph above one Space Mono message ('NO SAVES' / 'EMPTY SLOT') and a single yellow primary CTA; the glyph is aria-hidden and the state is written in words.
componentRecipes.panel: background: #16171c; color: #ececee; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 24px 32px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #000000; — the frame is a 23px slice stack pinned to the top edge: background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e8402a 0 8px, #f08a24 8px 14px, #f5c518 14px 18px, #52b545 18px 21px, #2f7fe0 21px 23px); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 23px; second line uses background-position: top; the body fill is a separate element below the 23px band so the band never repeats behind text. Optional scanline overlay from effects.scanlines at 100% cover with pointer-events: none; below 640px drop the shadow and keep the band.
componentRecipes.button: font: 400 14px/1 'Audiowide'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; background: #f5c518; color: #0a0a0d; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000000; transition: none; :hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #000000; background-image: effects.sliceStackHairline; background-size: 100% 12px; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding-top: 24px; } :active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #000000; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2f7fe0; outline-offset: 3px; } — secondary: #16171c fill, #ececee text, 23px slice stack as a 5px left column instead of the top band; destructive swaps fill to #ff4b3e with #0a0a0d text and never uses the rainbow.
componentRecipes.input: background: #0a0a0d; color: #ececee; font: 16px/1.5 'Space Mono'; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid #2a2b33; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 12px; caret-color: #f5c518; :placeholder { color: #86878f; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 12px; } :focus { border-bottom: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e8402a 0 5px, #f08a24 5px 8px, #f5c518 8px 10px, #52b545 10px 11px, #2f7fe0 11px 12px); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: bottom; background-size: 100% 12px; padding-bottom: 17px; outline: none; } — the focus state swaps the hairline for the full 12px micro-slice; invalid state keeps a 3px #ff4b3e underline plus a Space Mono sentence-case message, never color alone.
componentRecipes.statusbar: height: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 0 16px; background: #0a0a0d; border-top: 1px solid #2a2b33; font: 12px/1 'Space Mono'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #ececee; the leading cell is a 23px wide vertical slice stack (columns rotate the rainbow: #e8402a 0 8px, #f08a24 8px 14px, #f5c518 14px 18px, #52b545 18px 21px, #2f7fe0 21px 23px) with no label inside; segments separated by 1px #2a2b33 rules; live value in #f5c518, warning #f08a24, critical #ff4b3e; the blinking block cursor is 8px wide and animates steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite.
componentRecipes.menu: horizontal rail: item { display: inline-block; font: 400 13px/1 'Audiowide'; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 12px 16px 15px; color: #ececee; border-radius: 0; } the selected item keeps its plate #16171c, turns #f5c518, and gains the 12px hairline slice stack as an under-rule (background-position: bottom, background-size: 100% 12px, no-repeat) plus box-shadow 4px 4px 0 #000000; hover only lightens the label to #ffffff and never animates; group separators are 1px #2a2b33 vertical rules, and dropdowns are 1px #2a2b33 frames on #16171c with the selected row carrying the full 23px band on its left edge.

copywriting.voice: Publisher catalog and game-box label: confident, second-person, short declarative lines that name the thing and invite the action. It reads like the front of a 1983 box — a title, a one-line promise, three feature bullets — never like a SaaS landing page and never with a joke the machine is winking at.

case.body: sentence case for Space Mono running text; UPPERCASE for labels, buttons, and numeric readouts

avoid: stacked punctuation (!!!, ???) and exclamation-heavy body copy
Audiowide for paragraph text or below 14px
reproducing or approximating a real trademarked logo or wordmark
more than two rainbow bands on one component as decoration

do: Build every hero wordmark as a five-band horizontal slice: the same text split into red 8px, orange 6px, yellow 4px, green 3px, blue 2px rows with a 1px plate shift per band, so the thickness gradient is the logo.
Keep the 23px slice stack ratio (8/6/4/3/2) everywhere it appears — divider, panel rule, button hover, input focus, statusbar chip — and scale it only by whole multiples.
Choose one field per surface: #0a0a0d with the saturated rainbow, or #c9cbd1 with the desaturated silverField variant.
Set wordmarks, headings, and buttons in Audiowide or Orbitron uppercase at 0.02em–0.08em tracking, and keep the display strings to one to four words.
Use Space Mono for all running text, labels, and numeric readouts, uppercase at 0.12em tracking for labels and sentence case for paragraphs.
Treat the slice stack as the only depth cue: slices are flat and shadowless, and detached plates take the single hard 6px 6px 0 #000000 offset.
Pair every rainbow signal with a label so band order never carries meaning alone, and keep a solid 3px #2f7fe0 focus ring at 3px offset on every focusable element.
Animate only as five-beat stepped wipes or instant state changes at 0/120/360/900ms, and keep the effect purely horizontal.
dont: Don't reproduce, trace, or approximate any real Atari or Sierra wordmark, Fuji mark, or logo — the mode evokes a treatment, not a brand.
No smooth rainbow gradients, gradient blends between bands, or blurred rainbow glows; the bands are hard-edged stacked rectangles with a single color each.
No border-radius, diagonal cuts, chamfers, circles, or skewed letterforms — every edge in the system is horizontal and orthogonal.
No reordered, re-weighted, or randomly sampled bands: no thin-then-thick reverse stacks, no four-band or six-band variants, no pastel versions of the five rainbow colors.
No Audiowide or Orbitron below 14px or in paragraph copy, and no fake bold, italic, or outlined display type.
No eased fades, rotating logos, scaling wordmarks on hover, parallax, or backdrop-blur — motion is stepped or absent.
No pastel, cream, or mid-gray page fields: the ground is #0a0a0d or #c9cbd1, never a tint between them.
accessibility: Verify every pairing against the field you chose: #ececee on #0a0a0d passes easily, but #52b545 and #2f7fe0 do not pass on #0a0a0d or on #c9cbd1 — use those bands as fills, rules, and non-text signal only, and set text in #ececee, #0a0a0d, or #f5c518.
The rainbow never carries meaning alone: pair each band or stripe state with a text label (SELECTED, ACTIVE, ERROR, SAVED) so color-vision deficiency cannot hide the state.

Audiowide and Orbitron read from 14px up and Space Mono from 12px up; keep line-height at 1.5 or greater for running text, and never set a sliced band through the middle of a glyph's x-height where legibility collapses.

Honor prefers-reduced-motion: replace the five-beat band wipe with the final composed stack and the blinking block cursor with a static one — the sliced wordmark must read correctly with all animation removed.
Keep a visible 3px #2f7fe0 focus ring at 3px offset with no rainbow inside it, and give sliced decorative wordmarks a plain-text accessible name instead of exposing the band spans to assistive tech.

Never run a glyph across a slice edge or inside a thin band: labels sit on solid #16171c or #ececee fields beside the stack, and where a band must hold text it is 16px minimum in #0a0a0d on #f5c518 only.
signatureElement: The horizontal-slice thickness-gradient wordmark and divider: a title or rule cut into five stacked bands whose heights step thick-to-thin (8/6/4/3/2px) in red-orange-yellow-green-blue, each band plate-shifted 1px like slices off a printed logo.

prose.overview: Atari / Sierra Logo Treatment takes the one move that made 80s publisher branding recognizable and turns it into an interface system: a wordmark or divider sliced into horizontal bands, each band a slightly different thickness, each band a different rainbow color. The stack steps thick to thin — 8, 6, 4, 3, 2 pixels — so the mark reads as a printed logo cut apart on a light table and reassembled with a one-pixel offset per slice. Everything else stays quiet so the slice stays loud: dark or silver ground, geometric display type, orthogonal geometry, hard edges. It should feel like the front of a game box or a title screen, never like a retro filter applied to a modern layout.
prose.colors: The five rainbow bands are the palette — red #e8402a, orange #f08a24, yellow #f5c518, green #52b545, blue #2f7fe0 — and they are used in that order at those weights, always as a stack rather than a blend. The field is either near-black #0a0a0d with panels at #16171c, or silver #c9cbd1 with surfaces at #dfe0e4 so the same five hues drop to the desaturated silverField values and stay readable. #ececee carries text on the dark field, #0a0a0d carries it on silver, and #86878f or #5d5f67 is the only muted tone. Rainbow is never a wash behind copy: it lives in the banded stack, the divider, the chip, and the under-rule.
prose.typography: Audiowide is the wordmark voice — geometric, wide, logo-like — with Orbitron as its fallback and Space Grotesk behind that, always uppercase at 0.02em–0.08em tracking and never below 14px. The slice effect works on that broad, even-stroke letterform because the horizontal cuts land inside thick stems instead of across thin hairlines. Space Mono carries every sentence, label, and numeric readout: uppercase at 0.12em tracking for tags and status cells, sentence case for running text. Hierarchy comes from scale, case, and band weight, never from fake bold, italics, or outlined display type.
prose.layout: Layout is a poster grid: a full-width hero band holding the sliced wordmark, a content field beneath it, and a low status rail — anchored by 4/8/16/24/32px spacing steps and a 23px slice module that repeats as rule, divider, or chip. Alignment is strictly left and center; nothing is rotated, staggered, or optically nudged off the horizontal. The slice stack may span the full bleed at the top of a panel, or appear as a narrow vertical chip at the start of a rail, but it never runs at an angle. Long content sits in single columns of 60–72 characters so the display type stays a punctuation mark, not a wall.
prose.elevation: There is one depth cue and it is drawn, not lit: a hard 6px 6px 0 #000000 offset on detached plates such as buttons, cards, and dropdowns, with no blur anywhere. The slice stack supplies the system's other sense of depth — the bands appear to step back as they thin, which is the illusion that makes the wordmark read as sliced rather than striped. Slices and dividers are therefore always flat and shadowless, and the only glow in the system is a 6px blue halo reserved for focus-adjacent emphasis on the dark field, never on a rainbow element.
prose.shapes: Shapes are rectangles: radius 0, no chamfers, no diagonals, no circles except an avatar or a play dot when content demands one. The single expressive geometry is band height — a divider is a 23px stack, a panel rule is the same stack at the top edge, a micro-rule is the 12px hairline version, and a wordmark is the same five bands applied to letterform slices with a 1px plate shift. Corners are cut square by ending a fill, and imagery is flat two-or-three-color art with hard edges and image-rendering: pixelated when scaled.
prose.components: Panels are #16171c plates with the 23px slice stack pinned to the top edge and a 6px hard offset shadow; hero wordmarks apply the five bands to the display text itself. Buttons are yellow #f5c518 Audiowide plates on #0a0a0d text that lift by their shadow on hover and reveal the 12px hairline slice; inputs are Space Mono wells on a 3px rule that swaps to the micro-slice on focus; the status bar is a 28px rail led by a vertical rainbow chip; menus are horizontal rails where the selected item turns #f5c518 and gains the hairline under-rule. Every component owns at most one rainbow element — two is noise.
prose.dosDonts: Do build marks from the 8/6/4/3/2 slice stack, do keep one field per surface (near-black or silver), do set wordmarks in Audiowide uppercase and everything else in Space Mono, and do keep bands hard-edged and uninterpolated. Don't trace a real Atari or Sierra logo, don't blur or gradient the rainbow, don't round or skew a corner, don't reorder or re-weight the bands, and don't animate anything but a five-beat stepped wipe. The attribution note applies literally: evocation only, no trademarked logos reproduced.
